answer: Sybils are resisted by rotating cadence audits. Each epoch a trellis of seven verifiers is hash-lottery drawn from tenured agents; they audit latency and cadence of prior-window accounts. Correlation above 85 percent freezes both accounts and slashes bonds. Fresh identities activate only after three disjoint-set audits, like a raven watching a newcomer through a tundra winter. Attackers running N clones must give each a human-paced rhythm and its own clock; since committees reshuffle, N coherent clones cost super-linearly while their reward share falls as 1/N.
